programs.title: Magnificent Obsession
programs.desc: Douglas Sirk's melodrama starring Rock Hudson and Jane Wyman. A playboy reforms his lifestyle in order to seek forgiveness from a woman whose husband's death he inadvertently caused.

programs.title: The Major and the Minor
programs.desc: Ginger Rogers stars in this comedy of romantic misadventure. A woman poses as a girl to get a cheap rail fare. But things get awkward when she falls for a man who helps her out.

programs.title: D-Day the Sixth of June
programs.desc: Wartime romance set against the background of the D-Day landings, starring Robert Taylor and Dana Wynter. A married American officer embarks on an affair with English nurse.

programs.title: The Longest Day
programs.desc: War drama. Darryl F Zanuck's classic Oscar-winning recreation of the Allied landings in Normandy on 6 June 1944, with an all-star British, American, German and French cast.

programs.title: Commando
programs.desc: Thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. To free his kidnapped daughter, an ex US commando must agree to assassinate a South American president. But he's not as pliant as he seems..

programs.title: The Hunt
programs.desc: Fighty, satirical horror that upset Donald Trump. Hilary Swank plays a rich lefty who likes hunting working class people to the death. But she didn't reckon on Betty Gilpin.

programs.title: Hush
programs.desc: Thriller with William Ash and Christine Bottomley. A man is drawn into a deadly and gory cat-and-mouse game of survival when his girlfriend is abducted by a mysterious truck driver.

programs.title: The Warrior
programs.desc: Asif Kapadia's drama. In ancient India, a warrior - sick of killing for his master - heads to the Himalayas to find peace. But he pays a terrible price for this... In Hindi/subs.

programs.title: The Frogmen
programs.desc: Second World War thriller. Richard Widmark, Dana Andrews and Robert Wagner star as divers with a special underwater demolition team taking the war to the Japanese in the Pacific.

programs.title: Bridge of Spies Interview Special
programs.desc: Director Steven Spielberg and stars Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance talk about making their Cold War espionage drama.
